pass_b_english: We have been freed from blemish and justified through our faith in him, and through this faith, we have been enriched with the safety and protection that come from him, and we have been fortified with his grace, which repels every diabolical attack and the fierce rebellions of opposing powers.

This is a lesson that is taught to us as if we were being addressed as the Church of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, where it will no longer be possible for the uncircumcised and unclean to pass through.

Historically, the nations surrounding Jerusalem, which were uncircumcised and unclean, did not know God by nature and truth, nor had they received the pedagogy of the law, and they often fought against those of the blood of Israel, seeming to be stronger than the power residing in them, and trampling it underfoot.

However, when we interpret spiritual things from historical events, we see that the ranks of demons, the rulers of this darkness, and the profane Satan have underfoot the souls not yet generated by God, passing through them with no one hindering or defending, but when these souls have been glorified and strengthened by God, then the greed of those demonic powers will cease.
For it is written that an angel of the Lord will encamp around those who fear Him and rescue them (Psalm 34:7).
The abominable and unclean things are to be considered defiled and wicked, and they are contrary to God's power.
To Jerusalem, the Lord says, 'Shake off the dust, rise, and sit,' and to the captive daughter of Zion, 'Remove the bond from your neck' (Isaiah 52:2).
Then the Lord teaches clearly how she will put on the strength of her arm and the glory.

The dust that the Lord commands to be shaken off is not just physical dust, but also the earthly mindset and the uncleanness of carnal desires that cling to us, so we must shake off the dust, and this means removing the earthly mindset and cleansing our mind.

Just as those who lie on the ground are filled with dust and dirt, so also those who have an earthly mindset are filled with the uncleanness of carnal desires, and therefore, we who are called to spiritual intimacy with our Lord Jesus Christ and are about to put Him on as strength and glory must first shake off the earthly mindset and cleanse our mind.
